# Overview

- TKPlanner-iOS: iOS app for wedding/event planning (The Knot)
- Primary users: engaged couples, guests, vendors
- Key features: guest list, registry, planning tools, inspiration, chat, notifications
- Major modules: Account, Onboarding, Registry, Plan, Home, Notification Center, Marketplace, WeddingVision
- Integrations: Firebase, Google services, push notifications, in-app purchases, external APIs
- User flows: onboarding, event creation, guest management, registry linking, vendor search, chat, notifications
- App structure: modular, feature-based folders (e.g., Plan, Registry, Home)
- Shared code: App/Shared, GuestServices/Shared, MarketplaceCore, MarketplaceFeatures
- Testing: UnitTests, UITests, TestUtilities
